options.text: Ý nghĩa tiếng Việt: When a new practice is assessed with the client, it is also necessary to ask whether the practice felt like their own or imposed from outside.
Ý nghĩa tiếng Việt: A small initiative visible in the client’s daily life should be documented if it shows the right timing of support.
Ý nghĩa tiếng Việt: If a support method agreed with the client stops working, the reason must be clarified before concluding that the client’s motivation has weakened.
Ý nghĩa tiếng Việt: When the client asks for more calm at the start of a visit, the way of starting can be changed without giving up the goals of the visit.
